items.title: Drinks & Good Times
items.text: Get ready for cold drinks, shots with the crew, and the kind of laughs you'll still be talking about next year.

items.title: Bar Games & Shenanigans
items.text: Bar games and zero obligations. This is the part of the night where everyone loosens their tie and actually has fun.

items.title: Smaller Crowd, More You
items.text: A smaller, looser crowd after the big party. More face time with the people who matter most — no seating charts required.

items.title: No Agenda. Just Joy.
items.text: No toasts, no timeline, no pressure. Just Jeff and Paige and the people they love most, doing what they do best — having a great time.

cta.title: See You There
cta.text: No need to go anywhere — when the reception wraps up, just follow the crowd to the Stone Barn.
